provenance: AUTHORED - site-planning rules typed by the campusplan pack author; no real site, parcel, zoning code or survey is represented
yard_words_note: a hall gets an outdoor training yard behind its building when one of these words appears in the fixtures web/interiors.py derived for it, or in its registry name/focus (pack/registry/halls.json); every word must match at least one hall, or the build stops
slots_note: district order is the union registry's; district 0 keeps the north slot as today when there are three; with two, west/east so the south stays open for the gate
sims_yard_side_m_from: 2 x the builder's own maximum sims-yard radius (web/build_3d.py `const YR = Math.min(<max>, ...)`), read at build time
lots_per_side_choice: per district, the number of double-loaded spines k (1..6) that makes the block most nearly square (minimise max(width, depth), ties -> fewer spines)
